name: Atrius Health
campus_description: Atrius Health Boston Kenmore is a single multi-story office building at 133 Brookline Avenue, in the Audubon Circle / Fenway area near Kenmore Square and Fenway Park. Patient parking is in the building's own garage (validated $10) with kiosks on floors 2 and 3; on-street and Kenmore Square garages are also nearby.

parking.name: Kenmore Lot
parking.entrance_note: Closest parking to the Atrius Health entrance — about a 2-minute walk south along Brookline Avenue.

parking.name: VIP Parking
parking.entrance_note: Small lot just south of the Atrius Health entrance — about a 1-2 minute walk north back to 133 Brookline Avenue.

departments.name: Urgent Care
departments.check_in: Check in at the Urgent Care reception on arrival.
departments.directions: Walk along Brookline Avenue and look for the Atrius Health office tower at 133 Brookline — it's set back from the sidewalk with the Atrius signage above the street-level entrance. Go in through the glass main doors into the lobby and check the directory by the elevator bank for the Urgent Care floor. Take the elevator up and follow the signs to Urgent Care reception.

departments.name: Primary Care
departments.check_in: Check in at the Primary Care reception on arrival.
departments.directions: Walk along Brookline Avenue toward 133 Brookline — the Atrius Health tower is set back from the sidewalk with signage above the street-level entrance. Go in through the glass main doors and check the lobby directory for your Primary Care provider's floor. Take the elevator up, then follow the floor signs to your provider's suite reception.
